svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 8.98k stars in total, about 1.42k a year earlier. mr boxington 618, aube 2050, fnox 2319, hk 1287, pitchfork 698, usage 1063, +6 more 942.
